falsifiable_hypothesis: A causal Bayesian online change-point estimate of positive BTC drift improves the net return and risk-adjusted performance of a fixed prior-channel upside breakout by rejecting range-bound or adverse-regime entries without filtering out the large trends that produce the baseline's positive skew.
economic_mechanism: BTC exhibits persistent directional episodes separated by structural changes in return and volatility. A channel break is a transparent price-discovery trigger; the online regime posterior tests whether that break occurs inside a sufficiently persistent positive-drift state. The null is that the regime model reacts too late, overfits noise, or removes profitable breakouts without reducing enough whipsaw loss.

prior_family_evidence.btc_4h_sma_10_30: profitable development benchmark but rejected for calendar instability and excessive full-notional drawdown
prior_family_evidence.btc_volatility_expansion_continuation: rejected with negative raw and net development expectancy
prior_family_evidence.material_difference: This experiment uses a fixed prior-price channel plus a probabilistic online structural-break model. It does not tune an SMA crossover, reuse the rejected compression-expansion conditions, or use aggregate taker flow as alpha.

data.four_hour_rule: UTC-anchored bar containing exactly 48 consecutive accepted five-minute bars from one segment
data.daily_rule: UTC-anchored day containing exactly 288 consecutive accepted five-minute bars from one segment
data.gap_rule: All channel and online-regime state resets at a source segment boundary. No feature, entry, stop path, label, or exit may cross a gap.
data.lineage: The 2017-2025 price family has been inspected by earlier hypotheses and is development evidence only. The sealed 2026 aggregate file must not be read unless every frozen development gate passes.

breakout_baseline.decision_grid: close of each complete UTC four-hour bar
breakout_baseline.entry_condition: current completed four-hour close strictly exceeds the maximum high of the previous 120 contiguous four-hour bars
breakout_baseline.exit_condition: current completed four-hour close strictly falls below the minimum low of the previous 60 contiguous four-hour bars
breakout_baseline.entry: price-protected long at the first five-minute open after the completed decision bar
breakout_baseline.overlap_policy: one position; ignore new entries while long

online_regime.method: Bayesian Online Change-Point Detection with a Gaussian observation model and Normal-Inverse-Gamma conjugate posterior
online_regime.availability: State becomes available only at the close of a complete UTC daily bar and may be used by a four-hour decision at or after that timestamp.

prior.variance_source: sample variance of complete daily returns strictly before 2019-01-01
prior.beta_rule: discovery variance multiplied by alpha minus one

online_regime.state_statistic: MAP run-length posterior mean divided by its posterior standard error

primary_candidate.name: breakout_plus_online_positive_regime
primary_candidate.entry: Every baseline breakout condition plus the latest causally available daily state equals positive.
primary_candidate.exit: Use the identical stop, segment, maximum-hold, and exit-channel rules as the ungated breakout. The primary regime model is an entry filter only.
primary_candidate.sizing: 10 percent of current marked account equity, capped by cash; no leverage
primary_candidate.risk_check: A 4 percent stop plus the severe 80 bps round-trip cost assumption at 10 percent allocation is a 0.48 percent planned account loss before unplanned gap risk.

controls.btc_buy_hold: 10 percent of initial equity held in BTC across each accepted data segment under primary costs
controls.breakout_without_regime: identical channel, entry, exit, stop, cadence, sizing, and execution without the regime entry condition
controls.regime_without_breakout: enter at the first four-hour decision with a positive state and exit when the state ceases to be positive; diagnostic only
controls.regime_information_test: difference in next-seven-complete-day BTC log return between positive and non-positive causal daily states

statistics.primary_confidence_method: UTC calendar-month block bootstrap over filled trades
statistics.regime_confidence_method: source-segment-aware UTC calendar-month block bootstrap over non-overlapping seven-day observations

decision_rule: Any failed gate rejects this experiment ID before the sealed 2026 holdout. The breakout baseline, regime parameters, and sensitivities may not be replaced by the best observed development variant.
llm_boundary: No LLM output is used. A later LLM experiment may classify timestamp-safe event risk or veto new entries only after the deterministic price/regime candidate is independently accepted.
l2_boundary: The running L2 capture remains a separate background data-engineering workstream. Partial L2 data are prohibited, and L2 may be evaluated only later as an incremental execution or adverse-selection filter.
